abstract: AI is transforming digital services, and mobile apps, which routinely reach users far beyond their home markets, show just how global that transformation has become. This column shows that AI makes these products dramatically more attractive, increasing their user base at home and abroad by more than threefold. But when governments restrict the movement of data across borders, the gains from AI are halved. This creates a genuine policy tension. Rules designed to protect privacy, national security, and democratic institutions can also make it harder to build better products and spread the gains from new technologies.
abstract_zh: 人工智能正在改变数字服务，而移动应用通常能够触达远超其本土市场的用户，这恰恰表明这种变革已经变得多么全球化。本专栏表明，人工智能使这些产品极具吸引力，使其国内外用户群扩大了三倍以上。但当政府限制数据跨境流动时，人工智能带来的收益减半。这造成了一种真实的政策张力。旨在保护隐私、国家安全和民主制度的规则，也可能使打造更好的产品并传播新技术收益变得更加困难。

abstract: This paper introduces the experience-based pairwise comparison dynamics—a deterministic evolutionary process in which each agent, upon having the opportunity to revise her strategy, compares her realized payoff with that of another agent. The key departure from standard dynamics is that agents compare realized payoffs from actual matches rather than expected payoffs of strategies. Thus, agents need not know the population distribution of strategies and compute expected payoffs. In a uniformly random pairwise matching environment, this dynamic process is markedly more sensitive to the cardinality of the underlying game’s payoff structure than standard dynamics based on comparing the expected payoffs of different strategies. This heightened sensitivity yields equilibrium selection results in coordination games without the long waiting times typical of stochastic stability models. We further show that the strictly dominated strategy in the prisoner’s dilemma can survive.
abstract_zh: 本文引入基于经验的成对比较动态——一种确定性演化过程，其中每个参与者在获得修正其策略的机会时，将自己的实现收益与另一参与者的实现收益进行比较。与标准动态的关键区别在于，参与者比较的是来自实际匹配的实现收益，而非策略的期望收益。因此，参与者无需了解策略的总体分布并计算期望收益。在均匀随机成对匹配环境中，相较于基于比较不同策略期望收益的标准动态，该动态过程对 underlying game 收益结构的基数性明显更为敏感。这种增强的敏感性在协调博弈中产生了均衡选择结果，且没有随机稳定性模型典型的漫长等待时间。我们进一步表明，囚徒困境中的严格占优策略可以存活。
title: Experience-Based Pairwise Comparison Dynamics
title_zh: 基于经验的两两比较动态

abstract: Economies facing similar environmental challenges and broadly comparable policy interventions can nevertheless follow very different green-transition paths: some quickly adopt clean technologies, while others remain locked into carbon-intensive production. To account for this puzzle, we develop an evolutionary model in which market selection between clean and dirty technologies coevolves with environmental policy. A welfare-maximizing regulator taxes emissions and allocates the revenues between current pollution abatement and investments that progressively improve the environmental performance of clean production. This links short-run environmental policy with long-run technological change. We characterize the possible long-run technological regimes and study their evolutionary stability. We find that the same policy stance can support multiple stable long-run outcomes: economies facing identical policies may converge to different regimes depending on their initial technological composition, providing a theoretical basis for understanding the observed heterogeneity across countries. We show that policy can promote innovation even when only dirty producers are active, thereby paving the way for a green transition. We also show that even a predominantly green economy may remain vulnerable to the re-entry of dirty technologies. Finally, we analyze the ability of a regulator to dynamically adapt the policy mix, in order to redirect the transition path toward a predetermined long-run environmental target. Although adaptive policies can mitigate lock-in and path dependence, they cannot completely eliminate them. Finally, simulations show that more stringent environmental targets may even lead to outcomes opposite to those intended because of scale effects.
abstract_zh: 面临相似环境挑战、且政策干预大体可比的经济体，仍可能走上截然不同的绿色转型路径：一些经济体迅速采用清洁技术，而另一些则始终锁定于碳密集型生产。为解释这一谜题，我们构建了一个演化模型，其中清洁技术与肮脏技术之间的市场选择与环境政策共同演化。一个以福利最大化为目标的监管者对排放征税，并将税收收入在当前污染减排与逐步改善清洁生产环境绩效的投资之间进行分配。这将短期环境政策与长期技术变迁联系起来。我们刻画了可能的长期技术体制，并研究其演化稳定性。我们发现，相同的政策立场可能支撑多个稳定的长期结果：面临相同政策的经济体可能因初始技术构成不同而收敛于不同体制，这为理解所观察到的国家间异质性提供了理论基础。我们表明，即使只有肮脏生产者活跃，政策也能促进创新，从而为绿色转型铺平道路。我们还表明，即使是以绿色为主的经济体，也可能仍然易受肮脏技术重新进入的影响。最后，我们分析了监管者动态调整政策组合的能力，以便将转型路径重新导向预先确定的长期环境目标。尽管适应性政策能够缓解锁定与路径依赖，但它们无法完全消除二者。最后，模拟表明，由于规模效应，更严格的环境目标甚至可能导致与预期相反的结果。
title: Understanding heterogeneous green transitions: An evolutionary approach to policy, innovation, and technological change
title_zh: 理解异质性绿色转型：政策、创新与技术变迁的演化路径

abstract: The rapid growth of electric vehicles (EVs) has intensified peak load pressures on electricity systems. Time-of-use (TOU) pricing aims to alleviate this pressure by incentivizing intertemporal load shifting, yet causal evidence on its effectiveness, drawn from real-world, high-frequency charging data, remains scarce. This study employs a difference-in-differences (DID) model to evaluate the impact of TOU pricing on residential EV charging behavior, utilizing high-frequency hourly data from over 20,000 users in Shandong Province, China. Findings reveal that TOU pricing significantly reduces peak-period charging while increasing off-peak consumption, indicating a pronounced intertemporal substitution effect. Despite reduced peak demand, total charging volume marginally increases due to lower charging costs. CES model estimates detect weak own-price elasticity between peak and off-peak periods but significant cross-price elasticity. Welfare analysis indicates that TOU pricing enhances consumer surplus. Heterogeneity analysis reveals that users with higher peak-hour dependence and greater consumption volatility exhibit stronger adjustments. Overall, the findings demonstrate that TOU pricing not only mitigates peak load stress but also promotes EV usage and supports the electrification of transport. These results underscore the institutional value of TOU mechanisms in facilitating vehicle-grid integration and advancing coordinated development between the energy and transport sectors.
abstract_zh: 电动汽车的快速增长加剧了电力系统的峰荷压力。分时电价旨在通过激励跨期负荷转移来缓解这一压力，但基于真实世界高频充电数据对其有效性的因果证据仍然匮乏。本研究采用双重差分模型，利用中国山东省超过20,000名用户的高频逐时数据，评估分时电价对居民电动汽车充电行为的影响。研究发现，分时电价显著减少了高峰时段充电，同时增加了非高峰时段用电量，表明存在明显的跨期替代效应。尽管高峰需求下降，但由于充电成本降低，总充电量略有增加。CES模型估计发现，高峰与非高峰时段之间的自价格弹性较弱，但交叉价格弹性显著。福利分析表明，分时电价提升了消费者剩余。异质性分析显示，高峰时段依赖度更高和用电波动性更大的用户表现出更强的调整行为。总体而言，研究结果表明，分时电价不仅缓解了峰荷压力，还促进了电动汽车使用并支持交通电气化。这些结果凸显了分时电价机制在促进车网融合和推动能源与交通部门协调发展方面的制度价值。

title: Time-of-use pricing and peak shifting in residential EV charging: a quasi-experimental study from China
title_zh: 分时电价与居民电动汽车充电的削峰：来自中国的准实验研究

abstract: Exchange rate shocks can affect firms borrowing only in local currency when their banks suffer foreign currency loan losses. Using Hungarian credit registry data and the unexpected January 2015 Swiss franc (CHF) appreciation, banks’ CHF corporate loan exposure is associated with a contraction in local currency credit supply. Comparing banks lending to the same local currency borrower, a one standard deviation higher exposure is associated with about a 10 percentage point larger decline in local currency loan growth, on both the intensive and extensive margins. Consistent with a balance sheet mechanism, more exposed banks experience worse CHF loan performance and lower capital adequacy, and local currency lending contracts more for banks with weaker capital and liquidity. Local currency borrowers cannot fully substitute towards less exposed lenders, and investment declines when internal liquidity is insufficient. Foreign currency lending can transmit exchange rate shocks to local currency borrowers through banks.
abstract_zh: 汇率冲击只有在银行的境内外币贷款遭受损失时，才会影响仅以本币借款的企业。利用匈牙利信贷登记数据以及2015年1月瑞士法郎（CHF）意外升值这一事件，本研究发现银行对企业的瑞士法郎贷款敞口与本币信贷供给收缩相关。在向同一本币借款人放贷的银行之间进行比较，敞口每高出1个标准差，本币贷款增长的降幅约大10个百分点，且这一结果在集约边际和广延边际上均成立。与资产负债表机制相一致，敞口更高的银行其瑞士法郎贷款表现更差、资本充足率更低，而资本和流动性较弱的银行其本币贷款收缩更多。本币借款人无法完全转向敞口较低的贷款人，而当内部流动性不足时，投资会下降。外币贷款可以通过银行将汇率冲击传导至本币借款人。
title: Spillover effects of foreign currency loans: The role of the bank lending channel
title_zh: 外币贷款的溢出效应：银行借贷渠道的作用

abstract: We study optimal corrective taxation in a large economy where the aggregate action imposes a negative externality. Agents observe a public signal, which the planner also sees, and private signals, which neither the planner nor other agents see. Agents overreact to both by overestimating their precision. The optimal tax closes the gap between equilibrium and the social optimum, and decomposes into the tax rule that would be optimal under rational expectations and a behavioral adjustment. Conventional wisdom, derived from common-belief models, holds that the adjustment should make the tax more sensitive to the public signal. But that logic assumes agents act only on what the planner observes. Once beliefs are dispersed, the adjustment must instead work through the realized aggregate action, and its direct response to the public signal reverses sign.
abstract_zh: 我们研究一个大型经济体中的最优矫正税，其中总体行为施加负外部性。行为人观察到一个公共信号，规划者也能看到该信号，以及私人信号，而规划者和其他行为人均看不到这些私人信号。行为人对这两类信号都反应过度，因为他们高估了其精确度。最优税弥合了均衡与社会最优之间的差距，并可分解为在理性预期下本应最优的税收规则和一项行为调整。源自共同信念模型的传统观点认为，该调整应使税收对公共信号更为敏感。但这一逻辑假设行为人仅依据规划者所观察到的信息行动。一旦信念分散，调整就必须转而通过已实现的总体行为发挥作用，而其对公共信号的直接反应则符号反转。
title: Optimal Tax under Dispersed and Distorted Beliefs
title_zh: 分散且扭曲信念下的最优税收

abstract: Traditional market-timing tests such as the Treynor–Mazuy and Henriksson–Merton tests are known to over-detect timing ability when fat tails and state-dependent volatility are present, and are based on rigid parametric assumptions about the timing payoff. We propose a test of market timing built on the concept of timing fingerprint, a rank-based test that presumes no functional form for the timing payoff and is calibrated to nominal size by a null-imposing wild bootstrap. We show that, while the same bootstrap restores the size of the classical tests, the fingerprint method identifies the direction and location of timing-like behavior across the entire benchmark distribution and is substantially more powerful against timing payoffs the classical tests do not span. We assess the finite-sample performance of the fingerprint test using Monte Carlo simulations and employ it to evaluate a large panel of U.S. equity mutual funds.
abstract_zh: 传统的市场择时检验，如Treynor–Mazuy检验和Henriksson–Merton检验，已知在存在厚尾和状态依赖波动率时会过度识别择时能力，并且基于关于择时收益的刚性参数假设。我们提出一种基于择时指纹概念的市场择时检验，这是一种基于秩的检验，不假定择时收益的函数形式，并通过施加原假设的wild bootstrap校准至名义规模。我们表明，虽然同一bootstrap可恢复经典检验的规模，但指纹方法能够识别整个基准分布上类择时行为的方向和位置，并且对经典检验无法覆盖的择时收益具有显著更强的功效。我们使用蒙特卡洛模拟评估指纹检验的有限样本表现，并将其用于评估大量美国股票型共同基金。
title: The timing fingerprint: A rank-based test of market timing
title_zh: 市场择时的时机指纹：一种基于秩的检验

abstract: Suppose each individual in a community is given some fixed constant fraction of total available expenditures to spend. Samuelson (1948, 1954, 1956) argued that this would be a shibboleth (i.e., a procedure that doesn’t have meaning) because such a procedure cannot generally be rationalized by any social welfare function defined over the utilities of individuals. For modern collective household models, Samuelson’s shibboleth has been taken to imply that household resource shares (the fraction of a household’s budget allocated to each household member) cannot be constants. We show Samuelson’s claim depends on an assumption that is inappropriate for collective household models, and when that assumption is dropped, there is no shibboleth: resource shares can be any regular functions, including fixed constant fractions.
abstract_zh: 假设一个社区中的每个个体都被赋予总可用支出的某个固定常数份额用于消费。萨缪尔森（1948，1954，1956）认为这将是一种无意义的做法（即一种没有意义的程序），因为这种程序通常无法由任何定义在个体效用上的社会福利函数加以合理化。对于现代集体家庭模型而言，萨缪尔森的“无意义之说”一直被理解为意味着家庭资源份额（家庭预算中分配给每位家庭成员的份额）不可能是常数。我们表明，萨缪尔森的论断依赖于一个对集体家庭模型而言并不恰当的假设；当放弃该假设时，便不存在所谓的无意义之说：资源份额可以是任意正则函数，包括固定常数份额。
title: Constant resource shares and Samuelson’s Shibboleth
title_zh: 不变资源份额与萨缪尔森的示播列

abstract: We define and study obvious strategy-proofness with respect to a partition of the set of agents. This novel concept encompasses strategy-proofness as a special case when the partition is the coarsest one, and obvious strategy-proofness when the partition is the finest one. For any intermediate partition, the concept falls between these two extremes. We establish two general properties of this new concept and apply it to the two-sided matching model with one strategic side.
abstract_zh: 我们定义并研究了相对于代理人集合的一个划分的显然策略防伪性。这一新概念在划分为最粗划分时将策略防伪性作为一个特例包含在内，而在划分为最细划分时则对应于显然策略防伪性。对于任何中间划分，该概念介于这两个极端之间。我们建立了这一新概念的两个一般性质，并将其应用于具有单边策略性的双边匹配模型。
title: Obvious Strategy-proofness with Respect to a Partition
title_zh: 关于划分的显然策略防伪性

abstract: This paper examines the existence of political cycles in the awarding of World Bank procurement contracts around elections. We analyze elections in the home country of firms winning these contracts, distinguishing between firms based in the aid recipient country (i.e., domestic firms) and those from other supplier countries (i.e., foreign firms). Our findings indicate that domestic firms are more likely to secure larger contracts around elections in their home country, especially when corporate donations to candidates are allowed. Additionally, our results reveal an increase in contract sizes awarded to foreign firms before elections in their home country. This cross-border political cycle appears to be driven by strong aid partnerships and historical colonial ties between the supplier and recipient countries. These findings reveal a political dimension in procurement dynamics with potential implications for development resource allocation. Understanding these patterns can help enhance the transparency and effectiveness of aid-funded contracting.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了世界银行采购合同授予中围绕选举存在的政治周期。我们分析了赢得这些合同的企业的母国选举，并区分了总部位于受援国的企业（即国内企业）与来自其他供应国的企业（即外国企业）。我们的研究结果表明，国内企业更有可能在本国选举前后获得更大的合同，尤其是在允许企业向候选人捐款的情况下。此外，我们的结果还显示，在本国选举前，授予外国企业的合同规模有所增加。这种跨境政治周期似乎由供应国与受援国之间强有力的援助伙伴关系和历史殖民联系所驱动。这些发现揭示了采购动态中的政治维度，并对发展资源配置具有潜在影响。理解这些模式有助于提高援助资助合同的透明度和有效性。
title: Foreign aid and power play: Political cycles in world bank’s procurement allocation
title_zh: 对外援助与权力博弈：世界银行采购分配中的政治周期

abstract: Public support for wind energy in Germany is high, yet local opposition can impede project delivery. This study examines which socio-demographic characteristics predict acceptance of onshore wind energy and whether effects differ between urban and rural residents in North Rhine-Westphalia (NRW). We analyze a representative survey of N = 6284 adults fielded in September 2021, using survey weights. We focus on wind-salient outcomes (support for local wind expansion and landscape evaluations) and situate preferences for information, participation, conflict handling, and benefit-sharing as actionable process levers. Analytically, we (i) report weighted mean differences by place; (ii) estimate weighted least-squares models in which place of residence, political orientation, education, and age enter jointly; and (iii) test moderated regressions to assess whether urban-rural context conditions the influence of trust and perceived fairness. Results show that political orientation is by far the strongest correlate of wind-salient attitudes; education and age contribute only weak gradients that are not consistently distinguishable from zero, and the direct urban-rural effect is small and statistically indistinguishable from zero once other markers are held constant. Trust in scientists and planning authorities and perceived procedural/distributive fairness are strongly and positively associated with support; moreover, context matters: in rural settings, higher trust and clearly governed fairness arrangements are especially consequential. We discuss planning implications, focusing on the need to: embed co-designed, face-to-face participation alongside transparent disclosures; route information through credible intermediaries; and make siting criteria and revenue-sharing explicit and enforceable. The study clarifies how classic acceptance drivers interact with place and provides actionable guidance for tailoring engagement to different constituencies in Germany.
abstract_zh: 德国公众对风能的支持率较高，但地方反对仍可能阻碍项目落地。本研究考察哪些社会人口特征能够预测陆上风能的接受度，并检验在德国北莱茵-威斯特法伦州（NRW）城市与农村居民之间这些效应是否存在差异。我们分析了2021年9月开展的一项具有代表性的调查，样本为N = 6284名成年人，并使用调查权重。我们聚焦于风能相关显著结果（对本地风电扩张的支持和景观评价），并将信息、参与、冲突处理和收益分享方面的偏好定位为可操作的流程杠杆。在分析上，我们（i）报告按地点划分的加权均值差异；（ii）估计加权最小二乘模型，其中居住地、政治取向、教育程度和年龄共同进入模型；（iii）检验调节回归，以评估城乡背景是否调节信任和感知公平的影响。结果表明，政治取向是风能相关显著态度迄今为止最强的相关因素；教育程度和年龄仅贡献了较弱梯度，且这些梯度并不能稳定地与零区分开来；一旦控制其他标志变量，城乡直接效应较小且在统计上与零无法区分。对科学家和规划机构的信任以及感知到的程序性/分配性公平与支持呈强烈正相关；此外，背景很重要：在农村环境中，更高的信任和治理清晰的公平安排尤其具有影响。我们讨论规划启示，重点在于需要：将共同设计、面对面参与与透明披露相结合；通过可信中介传递信息；并使选址标准和收益分享明确且可执行。本研究阐明了经典接受度驱动因素如何与地点相互作用，并为在德国针对不同群体量身设计参与方式提供了可操作指导。
title: Gaps in mind: Political and spatial cleavages in local onshore wind attitudes in Germany
title_zh: 心理鸿沟：德国地方陆上风电态度中的政治与空间分歧

abstract: Against the strategic imperative of rural revitalization in China, this study examines how rural e-commerce contributes to rural revitalization and whether financial technology (FinTech) strengthens this relationship. Baseline regressions show a significant positive association between rural e-commerce and rural revitalization, and the result remains robust to an alternative measure of rural e-commerce, clustered standard errors, a restricted sample, and an instrumental-variable approach. Mechanism analysis shows that rural e-commerce significantly increases household income, supporting the proposed income channel. FinTech also strengthens the positive association between e-commerce and rural revitalization: the interaction terms for overall FinTech development, coverage breadth, usage depth, and digitalization are positive and statistically significant. Heterogeneity analysis further shows that the e-commerce coefficient is statistically significant in villages with larger household bases, greater land area, and larger labour forces. These findings provide empirical evidence on the complementarity between digital commerce and financial services in rural development and offer policy implications for inclusive, digitally enabled rural revitalization.
abstract_zh: 在中国乡村振兴战略要求的背景下，本研究考察农村电子商务如何促进乡村振兴，以及金融科技（FinTech）是否强化了这一关系。基准回归显示，农村电子商务与乡村振兴之间存在显著正相关关系，且该结果在采用农村电子商务的替代度量、聚类标准误、受限样本以及工具变量方法后依然稳健。机制分析表明，农村电子商务显著提高了家庭收入，支持了所提出的收入渠道。金融科技也强化了电子商务与乡村振兴之间的正相关关系：金融科技整体发展水平、覆盖广度、使用深度和数字化程度的交互项均为正且具有统计显著性。异质性分析进一步表明，在家庭数量更多、土地面积更大和劳动力规模更大的村庄中，电子商务系数具有统计显著性。这些发现为数字商务与金融服务在农村发展中的互补性提供了经验证据，并为包容性、数字赋能的乡村振兴提供了政策启示。

title: Rural E-Commerce and rural revitalization: the income channel and the complementary role of FinTech
title_zh: 农村电子商务与乡村振兴：收入渠道及金融科技的互补作用

abstract: This paper examines the impact of international intermediate input supply shocks on firms’ supply chain diversification and its adjustment direction. Using Chinese firm-level customs data from 2009 to 2016, we find a significant U-shaped relationship between supply shocks and supply chain diversification. When shocks are relatively weak, firms tend to maintain concentrated supply chains due to cost and efficiency considerations. Once shocks exceed a certain threshold, firms increase diversification to mitigate risks. Further analysis shows that firms adjust not only the degree but also the direction of supply chain diversification. In response to supply shocks, firms shift from efficiency-oriented to security-oriented sourcing strategies, increasing imports from countries with regional trade agreements, Belt and Road participation, and lower geopolitical risks, while reducing dependence on politically distant or disaster-prone regions. This paper reveals the dynamic trade-off underlying firms’ supply chain decisions and provides micro-level evidence for understanding how firms in emerging economies respond to global supply disruptions.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了国际中间投入供给冲击对企业供应链多元化及其调整方向的影响。基于2009—2016年中国企业层面海关数据，我们发现供给冲击与供应链多元化之间存在显著的U型关系。当冲击相对较弱时，企业出于成本与效率考虑倾向于维持集中化的供应链。一旦冲击超过某一阈值，企业便会提高多元化程度以分散风险。进一步分析表明，企业不仅调整供应链多元化的程度，也调整其方向。面对供给冲击，企业从效率导向转向安全导向的采购策略，增加从签订区域贸易协定、参与“一带一路”以及地缘政治风险较低国家的进口，同时降低对政治距离较远或灾害频发地区的依赖。本文揭示了企业供应链决策背后的动态权衡，为理解新兴经济体企业如何应对全球供给中断提供了微观层面证据。

title: Does international supply shock necessitate supply chain diversification? Evidence from China’s imports of intermediate goods
title_zh: 国际供给冲击是否必然要求供应链多元化？——来自中国中间品进口的证据

abstract: By means of a fine‐grained dataset linking exported product‐level and firm‐level data, this paper reconstructs the Chinese accumulation regime at the microlevel in the period 2000–2013. After documenting the trend of Chinese exports in international markets, and the appreciation in the terms of trade of manufacturing products, the paper provides evidence of the restructuring of exporting firms toward more complex products and sectors, against any hypothesis of a purported price dumping in international markets. The link between technological content of the exported product and pricing mark‐up strategies confirms the Sylos‐Labini hypothesis linking prices and technological advantage, yielding the formation of international oligopolies able to exert market power and set prices well above any competitive level. The trend in export prices has signalled the progressive capacity of the Chinese firms to penetrate the international market in most complex productions. Gains in productivity have been largely appropriated by profits.
abstract_zh: 本文借助一个将出口产品层面数据与企业层面数据相衔接的精细数据集，在微观层面重构了2000—2013年期间中国的积累体制。在记录了这一时期中国出口在国际市场上的趋势以及制造业产品贸易条件的改善之后，本文提供了出口企业向更复杂产品和部门进行结构调整的证据，从而反驳了任何关于在国际市场上存在所谓价格倾销的假说。出口产品的技术含量与定价加成策略之间的联系，证实了Sylos-Labini关于价格与技术优势相关联的假说，促成了能够行使市场势力并将价格设定在远高于任何竞争水平之上的国际寡头的形成。出口价格的趋势表明，中国企业逐步具备了在大多数复杂生产领域渗透国际市场的能力。生产率收益在很大程度上被利润所占有。

title: Profit‐Led and Export‐Led Accumulation Regimes in Chinese Manufacturing Firms
title_zh: 中国制造企业的利润主导与出口主导积累体制

abstract: The share of housing in private wealth has risen substantially across advanced economies over recent decades, alongside a near doubling of aggregate wealth‐to‐income ratios. On closer inspection, this global trend masks substantial regional disparities. While the housing wealth share changed little in the USA, it increased sharply in the larger European economies. This paper asks whether a standard asset‐pricing framework can account for these facts in light of the secular decline in interest rates. Comparing steady states calibrated to 1980 and 2017, I show that lower discount rates raise aggregate wealth only modestly, and leave the housing share essentially unchanged, because they capitalize housing and non‐housing income streams in roughly equal proportion. Matching the data requires two further mechanisms: an increase in markups, which lifts firm valuations through the present value of monopoly profits, and the presence of outright owners, which makes aggregate housing wealth more sensitive to house‐price increases by limiting offsetting quantity adjustments. Closed‐form expressions and a numerical calibration show that the interaction of these channels can reproduce both the global rise in the housing share and the USA–Europe divergence: in the USA, rising markups dominate, whereas in Europe, the expansion of outright ownership plays the central role.
abstract_zh: 近几十年来，在发达经济体中，住房在私人财富中的份额大幅上升，同时总财富与收入之比几乎翻了一番。进一步审视会发现，这一全球趋势掩盖了巨大的区域差异。美国的住房财富份额变化甚微，而欧洲较大经济体的住房财富份额则急剧上升。本文追问，在利率长期下行的背景下，标准资产定价框架能否解释这些事实。通过比较分别校准至1980年和2017年的稳态，我表明，较低的贴现率只会温和地提高总财富，并使住房份额基本保持不变，因为它们大致按相同比例将住房收入流和非住房收入流资本化。要匹配数据，还需要两个进一步的机制：加成率的上升，这通过垄断利润的现值抬高企业估值；以及完全产权自住者的存在，这通过限制抵消性的数量调整，使总住房财富对房价上涨更为敏感。闭式表达式和数值校准表明，这些渠道的相互作用既能再现全球住房份额的上升，也能再现美国与欧洲之间的分化：在美国，上升的加成率起主导作用，而在欧洲，完全产权自住者群体的扩大发挥核心作用。
title: The share of housing wealth and the decline in real interest rates
title_zh: 住房财富份额与实际利率下降

abstract: This paper investigates the educational legacies of Christian missions established before independence, in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, focusing on contemporary disparities in educational content, quality, access, and outcomes. Using georeferenced data from over 20,000 schools and two million students participating in the Examen National d’État (Exetat) between 2016 and 2019, as well as primary data from a phone survey of 624 school directors, we explore how proximity to Catholic and Protestant missions during the colonial period influences educational opportunities today. We find that schools near historical Christian missions offer a broader and higher-quality curriculum, with increased access to study tracks outside the basic Pedagogy section. Students attending these schools are more likely to pass the Exetat and achieve grades qualifying for university admission, although the magnitude of the effect is modest. Observable school-environment and quality characteristics attenuate the Catholic missionary-proximity coefficient by about half, while demand-side patterns point to additional differences in student composition. Our findings reveal that the strong partnership between missions and the colonial state entrenched spatial inequalities in educational access and quality, inequalities that persist to this day.
abstract_zh: 本文考察刚果民主共和国独立前建立的基督教传教活动的教育遗产，聚焦于当代在教育内容、质量、入学机会和结果方面的差异。我们使用2016年至2019年间参加国家考试（Examen National d’État，Exetat）的20,000多所学校和200万名学生的地理参照数据，以及来自对624名学校校长的电话调查的一手数据，探讨殖民时期与天主教和新教传教点的邻近程度如何影响当今的教育机会。我们发现，靠近历史基督教传教点的学校提供更广泛且更高质量的课程，并且更有机会进入基础教育学方向之外的学习轨道。就读于这些学校的学生更有可能通过Exetat，并取得有资格进入大学入学的成绩，尽管这一效应的幅度不大。可观察到的学校环境和质量特征使天主教传教点邻近性系数减弱约一半，而需求侧模式则指向学生构成方面的额外差异。我们的发现表明，传教点与殖民国家之间的紧密伙伴关系，在教育机会和质量方面固化了空间不平等，而这些不平等至今仍然存在。
title: Educational legacies of christian missions: Evidence from the Democratic Republic of the Congo
title_zh: 基督教传教的教育遗产：来自刚果民主共和国的证据

abstract: This paper studies communication failure regarding risks in the commons. It argues that strategic issues might explain why years of scientific reporting regarding future risks have failed to trigger sufficient climate awareness. We consider a game of contribution to a public bad, where there is uncertainty regarding the damage generated by externalities. Prior to the game, agents receive non-certifiable information regarding the damage from an informed utilitarian expert. We show that in large-scale public good problems information transmission usually fails. We compare this result with the cases of Rawlsian and anti-Rawlsian experts and discuss the implication for climate expert panels. We also investigate the influence of the value of information in our result, which provides us with some insight on the part played by deontology on scientific communication.
abstract_zh: 本文研究公共领域中关于风险的沟通失败问题。文章认为，策略性问题或许能够解释为何多年来关于未来风险的科学报告未能激发足够的气候意识。我们考察一个对公共有害品做出贡献的博弈，其中外部性所产生的损害存在不确定性。在博弈之前，代理人从一位知情的功利主义专家处获得关于损害不可认证的信息。我们表明，在大规模公共品问题中，信息传递通常会失败。我们将这一结果与罗尔斯主义专家和反罗尔斯主义专家的情形进行比较，并讨论其对气候专家小组的启示。我们还考察信息价值在我们结果中的影响，这为我们理解道义论在科学沟通中所起的作用提供了一些洞见。
journal: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
source_issue: Journal of Economic Behavior & Organization, Volume 251
title: Communication failure: The hidden face of the tragedy of the commons
title_zh: 沟通失灵：公地悲剧的隐秘一面
